source: Prototype genomic probe. BRAF alteration is common in papillary thyroid carcinoma; this rule is not a metastasis probability.
Prototype demographic probe motivated by the AJCC 8th-edition thyroid age cutoff of 55 years. Not an NGTA risk model.

condition: pathologic T category is T3, T3a, T3b, T4, T4a, or T4b
source: Prototype staging probe using AJCC pathologic T3/T4 categories. Not a validated nodal-metastasis rule.

condition: extrathyroid extension is Minimal (T3), Moderate/Advanced (T4a), or Very Advanced (T4b)
source: Prototype pathology probe using recognized extrathyroid-extension categories. Missing and unknown values are not evidence.
Prototype lactate probe at 4 mmol/L, a historical severe-sepsis screen. Not a Surviving Sepsis treatment instruction.

condition: minimum day-1 systolic blood pressure <= 90 mmHg
source: Prototype hypotension screen at a systolic pressure of 90 mmHg. Not an expert-reviewed NGTA rule.
Prototype age stratum at 75 years. Not a treatment threshold.
Prototype creatinine flag at 2.0 mg/dL. This is not a KDIGO acute-kidney-injury definition.
